name: @getcordon/cli
stderr:
Usage: cordon [options] [command]

Cordon for MCP — security gateway for MCP tool calls

Options:
  -V, --version    output the version number
  -h, --help       display help for command

Commands:
  start [options]  Start the Cordon gateway
  init             Generate cordon.config.ts and patch Claude Desktop config
  login [options]  Log in to Cordon (browser OAuth) and save an API key locally
  logout           Remove the local Cordon credentials
  help [command]   display help for command
